NEW TO THE MARKET

CHARMING 6-BEDROOM PERIOD RESIDENCE, FARMYARD & OUTBUILDINGS ON c.7 ACRES

CASTLEREA, CO. ROSCOMMON

GUIDE PRICE: €325,000

Nigel Dineen & Martin Finn Auctioneers are delighted to bring to the market this distinctive six-bedroom period residence together with an extensive farmyard, substantial agricultural buildings and approximately 7 acres of land, conveniently located just minutes from Castlerea Town.

Dating back to the 1890s, this impressive two-storey residence is full of traditional character and offers an exciting opportunity for a purchaser seeking a substantial country home with land, sheds and excellent yard facilities.

Approached by an impressive long, tree-lined private driveway, the residence occupies an attractive countryside setting offering privacy, space and tremendous potential while remaining exceptionally convenient to Castlerea.

The property is approximately 2 minutes from Tarmon National School and 5 minutes from Castlerea Town, making it particularly appealing to purchasers seeking the benefits of country living while remaining close to schools, shops and everyday amenities.

The substantial period residence retains much of its original character and proportions, including high ceilings and generously sized rooms.

The accommodation includes an entrance hallway, large reception/dining room and six bedrooms at first-floor level, providing excellent space and flexibility for family living.

While the residence offers considerable potential for refurbishment and modernisation, its scale, period character and attractive setting provide an excellent basis from which to create a truly impressive family home.

Externally, this property has much to offer.

Approximately 7 acres of land accompany the residence, together with an extensive enclosed farmyard and an excellent collection of agricultural and traditional stone buildings.

The farmyard includes a three-bay slatted shed, holding pen and crush, silage slab, galvanised storage shed and traditional stone outbuildings, providing excellent facilities for farming, equestrian, storage, hobby or other uses.

The combination of a substantial six-bedroom period residence, approximately 7 acres, extensive farmyard, excellent outbuildings and a highly convenient location only minutes from Castlerea makes this a particularly attractive and versatile country property.

ACCOMMODATION

Entrance Hall

Traditional entrance hallway providing access to the principal ground-floor accommodation and retaining the character associated with a residence of this period.

Dining / Reception Room

A generously proportioned reception room featuring the impressive high ceilings characteristic of this substantial period residence.

The scale of the room provides excellent potential to create an attractive formal dining or family living space.

Additional Ground-Floor Accommodation

The residence provides substantial accommodation with considerable potential for refurbishment and reconfiguration to suit the individual requirements of a new owner.

FIRST FLOOR

Six Bedrooms

The first floor provides six bedrooms, offering exceptional flexibility for family accommodation, guest bedrooms, home-office requirements or additional living space.

The generous proportions and traditional character provide considerable scope for a purchaser to restore and enhance this impressive residence.

SERVICES

- Mains water connected
- Septic tank
- PVC windows and doors

OUTSIDE

The property is approached by an impressive long private tree-lined driveway, immediately creating an attractive sense of arrival and providing excellent privacy from the public road.

The residence, farmyard and outbuildings stand on approximately 7 acres, providing generous space surrounding the property.

The lands offer excellent possibilities for purchasers with farming, equestrian, animal-keeping or hobby interests, while also providing the space and privacy associated with a substantial country residence.

FARMYARD & OUTBUILDINGS

A major feature of the property is the extensive enclosed farmyard and excellent range of agricultural buildings.

Facilities include:

- Three-bay slatted shed
- Holding pen and crush
- Silage slab
- Galvanised storage shed
- Traditional stone outbuildings
- Attractive arched access leading to the rear yard
- Extensive yard area
- Approximately 7 acres of land

The traditional stone buildings add considerable character to the property and may offer further potential for alternative uses, subject to any necessary planning permission and approvals.

LOCATION

The property enjoys an excellent countryside location while remaining remarkably convenient to Castlerea Town.

Tarmon National School is approximately 2 minutes away, while Castlerea Town Centre is approximately 5 minutes' drive, providing convenient access to supermarkets, shops, schools, sporting facilities, restaurants, public transport and everyday services.

This combination of a peaceful rural setting, substantial grounds and close proximity to Castlerea is one of the property's strongest attributes.
